categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Lante Optics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision optical components including optical prisms, glass aspheric lenses, and glass wafers. The company serves markets such as consumer electronics, automotive intelligent driving, semiconductor processing, AR/VR, and artificial intelligence. Its product portfolio includes micro prisms for smartphone periscope camera modules, imaging prisms for optical instruments, and large-size imaging prisms, as well as glass wafers used in display, semiconductor lithography, and automotive logo projection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced proprietary technologies such as ultra-high precision glass tooling, high-efficiency mass gluing and cutting, large-size prism processing, ridge prism processing, mold manufacturing compensation, multi-cavity hot molding, integrated lens barrel molding, and high-precision thin wafer processing. It also develops wafer-level optics (WLO) and through-glass via (TGV) technologies for semiconductor packaging. Manufacturing processes include precision grinding, polishing, coating, photolithography, and nanoimprint techniques, enabling high accuracy in dimensions, angles, and surface quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global leading enterprises in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, semiconductor manufacturing, and AR/VR device sectors. The company’s products are integrated into smartphone camera modules, automotive 360-degree surround-view cameras, automotive LiDAR systems, semiconductor lithography substrates, and AR waveguide lenses. The top five customers account for 68% of sales, with the largest single customer representing 43.54% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province. Its sales are divided between domestic and international markets, with international sales growing significantly by 282.91% in 2023, accounting for the majority of revenue. The company collaborates closely with global optical glass material suppliers and serves customers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lante Optics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical components supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision optical elements such as prisms, lenses, and wafers. It procures raw glass materials and auxiliary materials upstream and supplies finished optical components downstream to device manufacturers in electronics, automotive, and semiconductor industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven market expansion and innovation, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on new product development and core technology accumulation. Key R&D directions include micro prism processing, laser radar lens manufacturing, micro-nano optics, automotive lens technology, precision polishing, ITO coating and photolithography, and AR waveguide optics. It aims to enhance product competitiveness through continuous innovation, cost optimization, and scaling production capabilities, targeting emerging fields like automotive intelligent driving, AR/VR, and AI.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision optical components to industrial customers. The company follows a 'sales-driven production plus reasonable inventory' procurement and production model, with revenues recognized at the point of product delivery and customer control transfer. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales contracts, including domestic and export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lante Optics holds a leading position in the precision optical components industry in China, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a specialized 'little giant' company. It competes with international and domestic optical component manufacturers by leveraging advanced proprietary technologies, high-quality production, and strong customer relationships. The company has broken foreign monopolies in certain product segments and is widely recognized by global top-tier customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 754.5 million, nearly doubling (98.35% growth) from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 179.9 million, an 87.27% increase year-over-year. The company’s total assets grew by 18.76% to RMB 2.29 billion, and net assets increased by 8.56% to RMB 1.63 billion. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding sales in key product lines and markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lante Optics differentiates itself through its advanced proprietary manufacturing technologies that deliver ultra-high precision, high efficiency, and stable quality in optical components. Its products meet stringent customer requirements for angle accuracy, surface quality, and dimensional tolerances, enabling integration into cutting-edge applications like smartphone periscope cameras and automotive LiDAR. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and ability to scale customized production provide significant competitive advantages in high-tech optical markets.
